description: This file defines the interface RateRepository, a repository for managing Rate entities. It extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide CRUD and query capabilities for Rate objects, including methods to find rates by name and by active status and product application.

classes.name: RateRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Rate entities, enabling database operations using Spring Data JPA.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Rate entity by its name.

methods.name: findAllByActiveAndProductApply
methods.description: Finds all active Rate entities matching the specified product application.
